seo.title: Submit your CV — register with StarOrigin
seo.description: Register your CV once in two short steps. When a role fits, a StarOrigin recruiter calls you to talk it through first.

hero.title: Register once.
hero.lead: Share your CV and preferences in two short steps. When a role fits, a StarOrigin recruiter calls you to talk it through.

why.title: More than a job board
why.sub: Join a database of 8,240+ candidates our recruiters search every time a new mandate lands.
items: Matched to new roles — including ones that are never advertised
Confidential — your CV is never sent to an employer without your OK
A recruiter call before any submission, so you know the role, client and package
Opportunities across India, the UAE and the US

items.question: Who sees my CV?
items.answer: Only StarOrigin recruiters. We share your profile with a hiring company only after we've discussed the specific role with you and you've agreed.

items.question: How long do you keep my CV?
items.answer: We keep your details for as long as they're useful for matching you to roles, as set out in our candidate data notice. You can ask us to update or delete them at any time by emailing hello@starorigin.in.

items.question: Do I pay anything to register?
items.answer: No — registering your CV is free. sample

items.question: How soon will I hear back?
items.answer: We call when there's a role that genuinely fits your profile and preferences. If you've applied to a specific opening, you'll hear from the recruiter handling it. Meanwhile, you can browse live jobs.

items.question: Can I update my preferences later?
items.answer: Yes. Submit the form again with your updated details, or email us and we'll update your profile.

cta.title: Already have a role in mind?
cta.text: Browse live openings across banking technology, IT and HR, or sharpen your application with our career guides.
